CONTROLS.NAME: flatten
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Change from a spiral to a flat cave.

CONTROLS.NAME: simplify
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Fewer ridges. Also clears up noise when tunnel diameter is widest.

CONTROLS.NAME: churner
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Modifies the rotation ridges, can give you noise if you aren't careful.

CONTROLS.NAME: fov_in
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Field of View for the camera, a sort of zoom. Default 20%.

CONTROLS.NAME: xyOffset
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: XY Position in the tunnel for the camera.

CONTROLS.NAME: xyLook
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Change direction the camera looks in a hemisphere. To look all the way backwards, you have to use 'look back' toggle.

CONTROLS.NAME: look_back
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Smoothly change to looking backwards. Make sure you move xyLook away from center before using this toggle, or it will be jerky!

CONTROLS.NAME: col_presence
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Scene fully lit up, or fully dark and flashing.

CONTROLS.NAME: deeper_colors
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Earthy color scheme, or move up for deeper, more complex colors.

CONTROLS.NAME: media_width
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Media must be on! Defines how much of the tunnel the media covers.
